SMTO-SKL-0116 — SMTO couldn't find a connected Slack workspace

GUID: a0b768fb-37a6-5286-89fd-964845944981
Slug: slack-workspace-missing
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • This request needs a connected Slack workspace, but the one named doesn't exist, or none is connected yet (for example after it was disconnected). Nothing was sent to Slack.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to list your Slack workspaces, and check whether the one you need is there and shown as connected. The list shows which Slack connections SMTO has saved and which are ready to use.
  2. If it's missing or not connected, ask SMTO to connect Slack with your Slack OAuth App entry, and finish Slack's page in your browser. Connecting saves a workspace entry that SMTO can then use.
  3. Ask your Slack question again, typing @ and picking the Slack workspace entry from the list. Naming the workspace makes SMTO use exactly that one.

What success looks like

  • SMTO answers your Slack request from the workspace you picked.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't create a new Slack OAuth App entry just to fix this; reconnecting with the existing one is enough.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Slack workspace resolution found no slack_workspace record at the requested exact workspace_ref, or, with no reference given, no accepted binding and no saved profile whose authorization_state is available.

What this means

  • Exact workspace profile lookup is missing or workspace selection finds no saved eligible profile. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Exact workspace profile lookup is missing or workspace selection finds no saved eligible profile.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect workspace_ref and safe workspace discovery results.

How to fix it

  • Run slack.workspaces to list saved slack_workspace profiles and whether each is connected; connect the intended workspace with slack.connect (auth_app_ref plus an optional workspace_key) and pass its exact workspace_ref. Without a reference, SlackProfiles.workspace uses only accepted @ bindings or the single profile whose authorization_state is available.
  • Run slack.workspaces, connect the intended workspace, and supply its exact workspace_ref.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended workspace and principal are connected and selected.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
